title: Why I Moved from Audit to Information Systems
summary: What Big 4 audit taught me about data, and why I decided to switch paths.
content:
My first job was in Big 4 audit, where I learned to work with large amounts of financial data under real deadlines.

Over time I realized the part of the work I enjoyed most was not the spreadsheets themselves but building better ways to handle the data behind them.

That realization led me to information systems: the same attention to detail, aimed at building tools instead of only checking them.

title: Growing a Content Company to One Million Followers
summary: Four months, one million followers, and everything I learned about consistency.
content:
Running an automotive content company was my first taste of growing an audience from zero.

We posted consistently, studied which videos performed, and doubled down on what the audience responded to.

The biggest lesson: data does not just apply to dashboards. It applies to creative work too.
